content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for DHSGSU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for DHSGSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Guest Faculty posts at Dr Harisingh Gour Vishwavidyalaya Sagar is scheduled for 31 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they report on this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Guest Faculty position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies for the Guest Faculty position at Dr Harisingh Gour Vishwavidyalaya Sagar as per the advertisement DoFA/BM/GF/2026/310.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for DHSGSU Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for the Guest Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The qualifications vary by specialization, including Master's degrees in Business Analytics, Health Care and Hospital Management, or Banking and Finance, along with NET/PhD or equivalent experience as per UGC regulations.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any age limit for the Guest Faculty positions?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any minimum or maximum age limits for these Guest Faculty positions.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates if applicable.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Dr Harisingh Gour Vishwavidyalaya Sagar, Madhya Pradesh. The exact venue details will be in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Guest Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a contractual job?
faq.answer: Yes, the Guest Faculty positions at Dr Harisingh Gour Vishwavidyalaya Sagar are contractual in nature.
